notes.title: HOT DOG MONSTER UPDATE: TUMORONI RISING
notes.content:
MyFloppy Online is back with a bold new update! After months of fielding complaints from angry players, we have finally taken the two whole hours required to fix MyFloppy Online! forever(?)! For being so patient with us during this trying time, we gave everyone trophies and even included a brand new boss for players to contend with! Face off against the mighty Tumoroni- the hot dog avatar of malignancy.

Much has changed in the world of MyFloppy Online! After years of smoking and drinking hot dog water, Floppy discovered a bump on his testicle and has since been diagnosed with cancer! The only problem? He can't afford the cure stowed away in the bowels of the Shop Bing Bing fulfillment center! Hop in and help our studio pay off our debt to give Floppy a fighting chance! Take revenge against Tumoroni, the hot dog monster that irradiated Floppy to the point of illness!

notes.title: Operation Stimulus: Patch 0.31 Is Now Available!
notes.content:
When we first heard that that you were having issues with myFloppy, our advice was to stop playing and do something with your life. Instead of doing something constructive, you went out of your way to post your issues on the internet! That's more effort than we would have put into it. 

Fortunately for you, Shop Bing Bing (who we now owe a lot of money to) decided it was in our best interest to keep you happy. We had to use most of the cash everyone stole to payback ShopBingBing and even then, it still wasnt enough. We left everyone with at least 500G to continue working in the myFloppy community, and to be able to feed and take care of their little tikes!

[b]To oblige we are dropping the following fixes:[/b]
+ Fixed Steam Achievements
+ Update Special Characters Password Message
+ Attached User Profiles to Store Items that are not created internally
+ The Store now only pulls items that a user does not own.
+ Discord Integration, Links Fixed
+ Updated Registration Process + Better Registration Error Logging
+ Added Forgot Password Workflow
+ Fixed F1 Screen Resolution Controls
+ Fixed Economy Issues
+ Stolen Gold Now Capped
+ Users Gold Cant Go Negative
+ Fixed Passive Stat Drain
+ The myFloppy world interface has been purchased and indebted to ShopBingBing.
+ Added Search For Friends Function To Desktop
+ Added Help Button Functionality To Desktop
+ Added Patch Notes Window Relay
+ Fixed Gold Distribution From Item Purchases + Room Comment Notification

[b]In addition, we will be adding the following items to everyone inventory (applicable to those who signed up on or before 05/07):[/b]
+ A sweet ATM trophy symbolic of the events leading up to the catastrophic damage dealt to the myFloppy Economy.
+ A cool unique mask, representing some leaders of the party responsible for the destruction of myFloppy's fiscal services.
+ A really dope street bike.
+ A really dope bosozoku street car.

[b]Lastly, a new boss has taken over the world of myFloppy Online:[/b] Baron Bankroll, Destroyer Of Economies! With a very cool trophy rewarded to those who kill him!

notes.title: Play myFloppy now!
notes.content:
myFloppy is here!

So if you're thinking about adopting a pet, there are a couple of things you should know:
Dogs will run up your water bill.
Cats will eat your lilacs.
Birds come with a limited warranty.
Domesticated skunks are only allowed as pets in 17 states.
These pets [i]will[/i] all die. They will leave you.

Consider adopting a myFloppy virtual pet:
Floppy only pees in cyberspace, not in your laundry hamper.
Floppy will not die, although he may hate you.
Floppy is a 2 time competitive jetpack racing champion.
Floppy has a cooler house than you.
Floppy can remove all of the creme filling from Oreos using only two swift an well executed movements.

Adopting a Floppy is your calling and now is the time. You can make a difference in the life of a Floppy for only a few short minutes a day. Download now!

notes.title: Free myFloppy Plushy (See Details)!
notes.content:
Is your relationship with your Floppy the most meaningful relationship in your life? Yeah it is. You've spent precious time giving Floppy the life your parents wouldn't give you and it shows. We know that no other Floppy's home can compare to yours but we are going to do just that.

Play the game throughout the month of May. Create, interact and kill other players throughout the virtual cyberscape of myFloppy online!

At the end of the month, we will check each players room. Whichever player has the coolest, sickest, most insanely well designed room will be gifted this limited plushy!

Just imagine snuggling this plushy while you sob because your life fell apart while spending too much time with your virtual pet. We actually feel sorry for you.
